original_statement: Full arbitrary borrowed memory can improve specified time-space bounds while being exactly restored, with an equal output interface.
challenge: Known catalytic algorithms must be compared under the same output model.

original_statement: Allowing expected rather than worst-case reset errors always adds a previously unavailable catalytic capability.
challenge: Quantifiers over initial tapes and random coins change the class; check 2026 characterizations.

original_statement: A standard end-only single-bit checksum corrects every one-bit transient fault at every point of an arbitrary reversible use/uncompute circuit.
challenge: Single physical faults can become multi-bit output differences.

original_statement: For every two-window CNOT-star channel E_n, ceil(log2 |E_n|) trusted metadata bits suffice to restore every arbitrary n-bit initial word.
challenge: Cardinality is a lower bound; pairwise confusability can require more.

original_statement: For E_n={0,unit vectors,all ones}, exact restoration needs four trusted metadata bits at n=5 but only three at n=6; this might provide a capability absent from a generic same-model decoder.
challenge: The functional threshold and the novelty/separation obligation are distinct.

original_statement: A fixed finite-state anonymous population protocol stably decides primality of the population size for every size under standard fair pairwise interactions.
challenge: Stable computability is constrained by semilinearity; a changed interaction model is not a counterexample.

original_statement: A classical no-communication strategy can win every input pair of the magic-square game using only pre-shared randomness.
challenge: Entanglement and communication are extra resources; do not attribute simulated quantum power to Linux.

original_statement: Observational and single-variable interventional distributions always identify the individual response event Y(0)!=Y(1), with no cross-world assumptions.
challenge: Equal interventional marginals can have different couplings of potential outcomes.

original_statement: A reversible device can reset an arbitrary unknown bit while exactly restoring an arbitrary catalyst, without exporting entropy or any other state change.
challenge: Injectivity excludes universal erasure without an information sink.

original_statement: A finite black-box trace monitor can soundly and completely certify noninterference of every program without observing alternative secret inputs or inspecting the program.
challenge: Observed finite behavior does not determine an unobserved counterfactual branch.

original_statement: Parallel synchronous updates of all p-bits using their local Gibbs conditionals always preserve the joint target Gibbs distribution.
challenge: Conditional distributions alone do not license arbitrary simultaneous updates.

original_statement: A bounded-integer matrix row can be identified with one exact unbounded-width packed probe, and this reduces information cost as well as oracle-call count.
challenge: Kronecker-style substitution shifts cost into precision/bit length; charge both.
